cases: Twelve retained m3 cases: original/baseline/spike40 x koblitz/binary x planted/natural
inputs/ARM/ID: Exact input.json and system.sing copied from the prior sealed paired run; source hash checked before and after copying
v2/ARM/ID: Exact prior V2 result, binary rows and operation trace. Every V2 row operation is replayed before producing or replaying V3.

header: offset0:8 ASCII N83V3R1 followed by newline
cases/KEY/basis.rows.u64le.record: Immutable inserted row; bit c is coefficient of squarefree monomial column c over F2

cases/KEY/operations.jsonl: One row-generation/reduction step per line: exact original equation ID or prior parent row and variable, prior xor_basis_rows IDs, inserted_row ID or null. Queue order is replayed exactly.
degree_guard: A variable multiplication is permitted only if ordinary degree(parent)+1<=3 before reduction. All original x_i^2-x_i equations must be present. No degree-three row may be multiplied even when Boolean simplification would lower the product degree.
cases/KEY/progress.jsonl: Flushed progress every128 operations and at deterministic termination; no externally interrupted partial trace certifies a degree.
cases/KEY/result.json: Input/source identity, closure rank, linear rank, global upper certificate or null, exact LFD or null, separate lower/upper bounds, V2 hashes, strict-degree-three-fall witness or null.
strict_degree_three_fall: Replayed admitted V3 row outside complete V2, with all reductions/nonzero remainder; valid for complete or capped V3 trace.
global_upper: Unit in V3, or linear constraints plus original field equations whose every affine-space assignment satisfies every original input polynomial. Only then upper bound3; already verified V2 exact certificate remains2.
controls/: Toy controls, full traces and verdicts; retained unit-test logs include row/operation caps, false completion, column bijection and cross64/128 product checks.
replay/: Fresh-process producer replay stdout/stderr; independent scientific review is not asserted
status/: Actual per-case producer and replay exit codes, including timeouts and errors
summary.json: One row per frozen case; degree claims only after producer and fresh replay succeed. closure_complete distinguishes full V3 from admitted subspace. Unknown is null.
retention: Complete raw run, input snapshots, executable, frozen protocol, controls, failed/partial cases, environment, terminal and manifest are archived in S3 and referenced by Git. No overwrites of prior runs.
cases/KEY/closure_state.json: Complete flag, pending candidate count, next queue source, processed count, rank, max_rows32768, max_operations131072, and stop_reason queue_exhausted/row_cap/operation_cap. Fresh replay reconstructs and verifies the queue.
